content.rendered: I have never written a review before but felt the need to this time. We have been staying here while visiting family (under sad circumstances unfortunately) and we couldnt have chosen a better place. Its gorgeous- the photos dont do it justice! We stayed in Skylark and it was huge, quiet and kitted out with everything you need. The bed was mega comfy and the shower was really powerful!!Lovely underfloor heating made it so cosy but reckon it would be cool in the hot summer months too. The games room was out of this world- although we didnt use it we had a peek- it has snooker, table tennis, table football, darts, tv, computer games, boards games, millions of books…..all in an amzing barn building. And the views were spectacular! The owners have been great- really accomodating and helpful which was excatly what we needed- we have been staying there on and off for the last month. And some of the cottages allow dogs too- some lovely walks around that our dog loved! We cant recomend this place, or the owners, enough. Great for romantic getaways, holidays with friends, business stays etc. We will definitely be back for a holiday in the future!

title.rendered: Wonderful country views in cosy newly converted barns – Sue and John

content.rendered:
We stayed here while visiting friends and what an absolute gem! On arriving quite late we received a warm welcome from Liz and were delighted with our cottage. Our room had a mezzanine floor for the bedroom with very comfy bed and ensuite with decent shower. 

These are newly converted farm buildings which have been built to an excellent standard on a working arable farm on top of a hill. There are lovely views and excellent opportunities for walks to local pubs, lakes for bird watching and we found a ruin of an abbey nearby too! Bring your walking boots and work up an appetite then cook yourselves or wander alongside the gravel lakes and river Idle enroute to the pub and eat there, we did both.

If you forget your book then there are some to borrow and board games and also a FULL size snooker table , ping pong and table football. A truly great place to stay, its like having your own private hill to live on! We will return!
Sue and John
